entities.name: UniProt O31642 YjdA
observations: Exact sequence match to the 251-aa query; reviewed Bacillus subtilis protein annotated broadly as an oxidoreductase acting on CH-OH group donors (GO:0016614), without a specific EC number.

33.2% identity over 96.8% query coverage to Aquifex aeolicus FabG; this supports a hypothesis of NADPH-dependent beta-ketoacyl-ACP reduction in fatty-acid elongation, but does not establish YjdA substrate specificity.
